title: FOOTBALL | Anthony Evans III Press Conference - 11/16/26
text: All right, guys. Got a question. >> A uh we've seen San Frisco continue to make plays uh over the last few weeks. As somebody who's been here the last few years and seen him develop, what's what's he doing behind the scenes? What's he been working on in his game to grow this way? >> Uh really just, you know, that was a big thing last year, just telling him to play how he knows how to play. You know, I felt like he was really thinking a little bit too much coming in and playing early. And you know, really, we was just been preaching to him, just use your body, use your skill set that you've been blessed with, and just go up and make plays. And seems like that's what he's doing now. >> Coach is talking about some guys are maybe on the fence about going through senior day activities, kind of figuring this thing out. Kind of where are you in that? I mean, do you do you plan to come back next year or where are you in that decision- making process? Uh, honestly, I don't really know, but I am going to walk because, you know, I've been in college four years and, you know, that's just a blessing to be able to get to do that as a senior, you know, go down there with my family. So, I definitely am going to walk, do the little senior events or whatever. But, as of right now, I don't have an answer whether I'm coming back or not. >> You going to have any family walking with you this year? >> For sure. I'm going to have my mom, dad, and my little brother, and probably my girl or something like that. I don't really know yet, but definitely those three or four. I >> think we've asked you this question a few times now in the last month or two, but just with another quarterback injury, just what can you do to keep helping this offense and be a little bit more productive these next two games? Uh, >> I think it's just keep trying to talk to him and tell him just to trust us to make plays. you know, we got guys who can make plays with the ball. So, you know, just trying to make it easy for them as possible. So, that's really it. >> And just talk about the last couple of years for you being at Mississippi State and how much have you grown and develop as a receiver. >> Uh, it's really just, you know, being able to play in this offense is just trust myself, you know, rely on my skill set, you know, my speed and, you know, just it's really opened my eyes to just how great I really am. because, you know, in my early college days, you know, I wasn't really getting the opportunities that I'm getting now. So, you know, being blessed to come here and getting those opportunities that I'm getting now is just really opening my eyes on how talented I really am. So, blessing. Anything else? All right. Thank you guys. Yes, >> sir. Appreciate it. Appreciate
